cohort: The study included pregnant women presenting with complaints of pruritus.
finding: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (IHCP) was the most prevalent specific dermatosis of pregnancy, associated with preterm deliveries, a higher rate of induction, and LSCS.
mod_finding: IHCP had a maximum number of preterm deliveries (36%), 48.5% of subjects had LSCS, and induction was done in 45.4%.
birth_weight: Birthweight was documented as an outcome.
gest_age: Preterm deliveries were documented as an outcome, indicating relevance to gestational age.
